I don't think it's worth the work, even if it sounds more logical. Think about it, what cost do throwaway accounts put on anyone? Not the user, he just needs to enter a username and a password (it's another thing on sites demanding email verification, but as said, not here.). He doesn't even have to remember the new password if he strictly wants to create a throwaway.

So, one might think it would be easier on the voat servers, not having to create new accounts all the time? Wrong again. Space-wise, the overhead of a new account takes up at most a few kilobytes on the voat databases (The post itself would take up space anyway, so I'm not counting that), probably even less. And you know what's far more valuable than that? A second of @Atko, or any developer's, time.

So in short: I don't think it will ever be worth it.
